title: Malone's Weekly Pool Challenge
headline: Malone's Weekly Pool Challenge
intro: Weekly 8-ball matchups at Malone's Pub in Downtown Fort Worth. Players are assigned an opponent each week, play Best of 3, and report scores after the match.
details: Weekly matchups are posted every Monday.
Each player is assigned an opponent for the week and may play any time during that week.
Every match is Best of 3 games of 8-ball.

sections.title: Format
rules: Weekly matchups will be posted.
Each player is assigned an opponent for the week.
Matches may be played any time during that week.
Each match is Best of 3 games.
Game format is 8-ball.
No BYEs: every player plays every week.

sections.title: No-BYE Format
rules: If there is an odd number of players, one player will be assigned two matches that week.
The double-match assignment will rotate weekly.
No player will be assigned two matches again until every active player has had a turn.

sections.title: Match Rules
rules: Call shot on every shot.
Scratch on the 8-ball is loss of game.
Winner breaks the first game; breaks alternate after that.
No coaching during matches.
Any dispute is settled by the bartender or tournament organizer.

sections.title: Scoring
rules: Match win = 1 point.
Match loss = 0 points.
A player assigned two matches in a week may earn up to 2 points.

sections.title: Handicap System
sections.intro: Handicaps are used during regular weekly play to keep matches competitive.
rules: Tier A: Advanced.
Tier B: Intermediate.
Tier C: Beginner.
Tier A vs. Tier C: Tier C wins the match by winning 1 game; Tier A must win 2 games.
All other matchups use standard Best of 3: first player to win 2 games wins the match.
Player tiers are assigned by Malone's Pub or the league organizer.
Tiers may be adjusted between league cycles.
Tier assignments are final during the current cycle.

sections.title: Reporting Scores
rules: The winner is responsible for reporting the final score to the bartender or organizer.
Scores should be reported as: Player A defeats Player B, 2-0.
Scores should be reported as: Player A defeats Player B, 2-1.

sections.title: Forfeits
rules: Players are expected to make a reasonable effort to complete their assigned match during the week.
If a player fails to complete the match without reasonable communication, that player may receive a 2-0 forfeit loss.
Repeated missed matches may result in removal from the active rotation.

sections.title: Inactivity
rules: A player who misses 2 consecutive weeks may be marked inactive.
Inactive players are removed from weekly matchups.
Returning players may re-enter the league at the bottom of the rotation.

sections.title: Monthly Finals
rules: At the end of each league cycle, the Top 4 players advance to a finals night.
Winners advance to the championship match.
No handicaps are used during finals.

sections.title: League Spirit
rules: This league is meant to be competitive, social, and fun.
Respect the game, respect your opponent, and respect the bar.
Play fast. Report scores. Have fun.
